title: Borrowing
description:
Write these functions with the right kind of reference:

```rust
fn add_score(scores: &mut Vec<u32>, score: u32) -> usize   // adds the score, returns the new count
fn best<'a>(scores: &'a [u32]) -> Option<&'a u32>          // a reference to the highest score (the first on a tie)
fn normalize(words: &mut [String])                          // trims and lower-cases each word in place
fn swap_ends(values: &mut [i32])                            // swaps the first and last items (if there are at least two)
fn count_starting(words: &[String], prefix: &str) -> usize  // ignoring case
```

The `'a` in `best` says the returned reference points into `scores`; lesson 4.04 explains it.
hints: `best` returns a reference into the slice, not a copy: loop over `scores` (which gives `&u32` items) and remember the reference to the largest.
To replace a `String` in place through `&mut`, assign to `*w`: `*w = w.trim().to_lowercase();`.
